description: Close a Discord poll the Hermoso bot posted, before its time is up. PERMANENT: nobody can vote afterwards and a closed poll cannot be reopened. Call it WITHOUT confirm first: nothing changes and you get the votes so far to show the user. Discord only lets the bot end its own polls. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

channel.description: the channel id or #name, when messageId is a bare id

confirm.description: true only once the user agreed

discordServer.description: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several

messageId.description: the message, as post_to_discord or read_discord_channel returned it ("<channel>/<message>", or a bare id with channel)

name: end_discord_poll
title: End a Discord poll early
